hypothesis: A compact prompt with a deterministic terminal handoff after two delivered adjacent test/fixture reads recovers task-3 evidence selection with fewer tokens.
mechanism: Overlay only the compact representation module. Once the rendered history includes at least 12 assistant messages and two successful delivered test/spec/fixture source reads, show a finalize-now system instruction and only the terminal submission tool. No benchmark-labeled paths, source bytes, gold data, or scorer changes.
sequence_rule: Run task 3 first. If it fails fixed quality or token screen, stop without task 2. Only if task 3 passes, run task 2. No replacement or silent retry.
screen_rule: Task 3 must meet or exceed DSH Span-F1 0.5125361243 and File-F1 0.8 using at most 261037 tokens. If it passes, task 2 must retain perfect Span/File-F1 using at most 461176 tokens. Every dispatched call must have known usage and each native export must be valid.
gold_boundary: Generation mounts source-only task and pinned repository data, not gold or reference patches. Native scoring follows sealed generation.
claim_ceiling: Two exposed tasks under a configured 1M window; no full-cohort or occupied-deep-window generalization.
open_questions: Will the rendered checkpoint trigger after adjacent test evidence?
Can task 3 recover quality within the token ceiling?
Will task 2 precision hold if task 3 passes?
